CES-D (French validated version), self-report: mean of the 18 items given, rebuilt from the somatic (7 items), depressed-affect (7) and positive-affect (4) subscale means; each mean x its item count is rounded because the means are stored to 3 decimals. Higher = more symptoms. DEPPOS is not reversed again: the paper reports it reversed and it correlates +0.58 and +0.66 with the other two subscales. Study-supplied subscale means from a file the contributor labelled as imputed; imputation method, scope and counts not documented; every mean is over all of its items; missing-item rule not documented.

notes: Instrument, subscales and reversal from Tardif-Grenier et al. 2021 (doi:10.1007/s11126-021-09895-x); the 0-3 scoring is read from the supplied means, which fall on whole-number 0-3 item steps.

SCARED-R (French adaptation), self-report: mean of the 18 items given, the instrument's total over the items administered, rebuilt from the somatic/panic (7 items), generalised anxiety (7) and traumatic stress (4) subscale means; each mean x its item count is rounded because the means are stored to 3 decimals. Items 0 almost never to 2 often, higher = more anxiety. The traumatic-stress items are counted here and have no row of their own. Study-supplied subscale means from a file the contributor labelled as imputed; imputation method, scope and counts not documented; every mean is over all of its items; missing-item rule not documented.
